title: I Found a 10-Second Time Machine ⏪ #Shorts #Animation
description:
I found a retro remote with a glowing red button that rewinds reality by 10 seconds! I fixed every mistake and dodged every disaster... until my 800th rewind, when a stranger in the crowd stared right at me, completely immune to time reversal! Would you keep the remote if each click cost 1 month of your life (Option A) or destroy it (Option B)? Vote below!
